answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 40845 Country: India Title: Zakah Money Question: I have a cousin sister who and their husband are not financially well off, they have a debt of around 5 lakh and her husband is not well for quite some time, her husband insists that he would never ever take zakah, but my sister has asked me for zakah. Can she take zakah without her husband’s knowledge? She says in case her husband comes to know this it could become a very big problem. How can we help her? Also can I give her money that I have accumulated out of interest in a saving bank account? Answer ID: 40845 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1232/811/H=1433) (1) It is better for you that you do not have any contact to your cousin rather develop friendly relation to her husband and ask the complete detail of their condition. And when it is clear that she is entitled to receive zakah then give him zakah money in privacy without telling that it is zakah and tell him that he may pay his debt from this money and may use it in his needs. If he takes the amount into his possession then your zakah shall be paid. It is not necessary to tell him that it is zakah amount. (2) If they are poor then it shall be right to give this amount as well and you may adopt the same method which has been written above. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
